label: v236
changes: Tell the assistant about your plumber, electrician, boiler service or locksmith and it now files them under Household vendors — with the out-of-hours number, the account reference, and a star if they're the one you always call. It couldn't write to that list at all before.
A locksmith goes to the vendor list now instead of sitting among your contacts, next to the lock and key details they'd ask you for.
You can also ask it to update one — “the plumber came again on Tuesday” — rather than ending up with the same firm twice.
Fixed: undoing something the assistant filed into Contacts, Important numbers or Providers could wipe your whole household vendor list. No warning, nothing to notice.
